name: Wave Spam Helper
description: Direction-aware wave spam smoothing with an adjustable input buffer

enabled.name: Enable spam helper
enabled.description: Wave only, works in normal and practice modes, assisted gameplay

strength.name: Smoothing strength
strength.description: Higher values pull timing harder toward the estimated rhythm and direction

buffer-ms.name: Input buffer in milliseconds
buffer-ms.description: Adds latency to detected spam, larger values allow more timing correction

show-hud.name: Show diagnostics
show-hud.description: Show activation state, learned pace, hold bias and queued edges
